story: Ma Krupa Construction began in 2004 with a single 12,000 sq.ft. weaving shed in Pandesara and a promise the founder made to the client in person: the keys would be handed over on the date written on the contract, not the date that suited the builder.

Twenty-one years later that promise is still the operating rule. Forty-eight delivered projects across commercial, industrial, residential and farmhouse segments have averaged 2.4 months ahead of their committed possession date, and not one has attracted a delay compensation claim.

We remain deliberately mid-sized. Design, execution and handover sit under one roof in Surat, so the engineer who pours your slab is the one who answers for the snag list. It is a slower way to grow and a much harder promise to break.
mission: To build spaces that outlast the people who commissioned them, and to make the buying of those spaces plain, documented and free of surprises.
vision: To be the developer that Gujarat businesses and families recommend without being asked, because the building still performs a decade after handover.

values.title: Integrity in Writing
values.text: If it is not in the agreement it is not a promise. Everything we commit verbally goes into the document you sign.

values.title: Time is the Product
values.text: A delayed handover costs you rent, interest and patience. We plan backwards from the possession date and staff accordingly.

values.title: Engineering First
values.text: Structural decisions are made by engineers, not by the sales sheet. Where the two conflict, the engineer wins.

values.title: Open Sites
values.text: Booked customers may visit any working day. A builder who cannot show you the site mid-construction is telling you something.

values.title: Built to Last
values.text: We specify for a thirty-year horizon: waterproofing, ventilation and services chosen for maintenance cost, not for the brochure.

values.title: After the Keys
values.text: Society formation, corpus handover and the five-year defect liability are part of the job, not a favour.

timeline.title: The First Shed
timeline.text: Founded in Surat with a single 12,000 sq.ft. weaving shed contract at Pandesara.

timeline.title: Into Commercial
timeline.text: First commercial trading centre delivered at Udhna, 84 units, fully sold before completion.

timeline.title: Residential Debut
timeline.text: Entered residential development with a 96-home project at Katargam.

timeline.title: RERA From Day One
timeline.text: Registered as a promoter with GujRERA in the first year of the Act and moved every live project onto escrow discipline.

timeline.title: Industrial at Scale
timeline.text: Delivered 64 weaving sheds at Pandesara four months ahead of schedule, through the pandemic.

timeline.title: Farmhouse Vertical
timeline.text: Launched the gated farm-plot vertical on the Kamrej belt with clear NA title on every plot.

timeline.title: 32 Lakh Sq.Ft.
timeline.text: Crossed 32 lakh sq.ft. developed across 48 projects, with four verticals running in parallel.

process.title: Discovery
process.text: We understand the requirement, budget and timeline, then show you only what genuinely fits. No blanket brochure dump.

process.title: Design and Costing
process.text: Drawings, specification sheet and a line-by-line cost sheet on RERA carpet area, so you compare like with like.

process.title: Agreement
process.text: Registered agreement with the possession date, payment milestones and specification schedule written in.

process.title: Execution
process.text: Construction against a published schedule, with monthly progress photos and cube-test reports available to you.

process.title: Quality and Snagging
process.text: Third-party structural audit, documented snag list, and every item closed before we call you for handover.

process.title: Handover and After
process.text: Keys, documents, society formation and corpus, then five years of defect liability that we actually honour.
